method.scope: 35 national-panel municipal administering awards; exact count computed below. State/county award horizon QPRs separately retained.
steps: Search each municipal grantee name in HUD public recipient service; retain exact grant IDs and all returned QPR periods/publication dates and current action plans.
Search official city domains for CDBG-DR quarterly reports, action plans and amendments; retrieve listed indexes and preserve receipts.
Enumerate candidate links; keep every unverified link separate from PDF-verified grant and period. Page labels can contain errors.
Retrieve exact-horizon PDFs and compare grant ID, report period, review status, period/To-Date columns, source hash and page. Preserve alternate versions and failed requests.
Use offline transformer retrieval to rank relevant pages of retrieved public documents; verify source pages manually/deterministically before accepting facts.
known_gaps: Current city pages may omit historic links or load them dynamically. Linked amendment bodies and non-horizon quarters are mostly not read.
Search-index discovery and one-level link enumeration are not exhaustive; unlinked or inaccessible records may remain.
Fort Worth index HTTP 403 was not bypassed. Birmingham TLS failure prevented original PDF/layout verification.
Initial execution semantics remain unverified for most of the OIG effective-date candidates; no automatic award clocks assigned.
method.prior_method_gap: V3 primarily used HUD recipient metadata and exact horizon matching. It did not systematically enumerate each city archive. A missing HUD listing is now explicitly only a portal gap, not evidence no public report exists.
